entry.title: New: Resolution 434 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO KA LA‘I A ‘EHU TO ASSIST WITH EXPENSES RELATED TO THE LĀ ‘EHUNUI 2024 EVENT IN WEST HAWAI‘I

Transfers $7,700 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 8)
